question: Should assistant-message copying expose Markdown and plain-text choices, and what content should the plain-text representation preserve for links, code blocks, lists, tables, and truncated messages?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally exposes Markdown, while neither the second interaction nor its representation semantics are defined by existing docs or tests; a saved preference would also introduce broader product and settings surface.

options.title: Add compact format selector
options.body: Offer Markdown and plain text from the existing footer action with explicit conversion behavior and focused clipboard/UI proof.

options.title: Keep Markdown only
options.body: Preserve the current explicit Markdown action and decline the additional copy representation.

options.title: Add persisted default
options.body: Store a preferred copy format, accepting a broader settings and compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Add compact format selector
recommendation.body: Offer Markdown and plain text from the existing footer action with explicit conversion behavior and focused clipboard/UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The original implementation history provides the strongest available ownership signal for this product choice.
